import chess

# Set up the position from the image analysis
# White: King g1, Queen d7, Rook a5, Bishop a3, Knight h4, Pawns f2, g2, h2
# Black: King g8, Queen g6, Knight b7, Bishop g3, Pawns f7, g7, h7
# White to move

fen = "6k1/5ppp/1n3Q2/6q1/8/1b1R4/P1B3PN/6K1 w - - 0 1"
# Let me verify: 
# Rank 8: 6k1 -> squares a8-f8 empty, g8 black king, h8 empty
# Rank 7: 5ppp -> a7-e7 empty, f7 black pawn, g7 black pawn, h7 black pawn
# Rank 6: 1n3Q2 -> a6 empty, b6 black knight, c6-f6 empty, g6 white queen? Wait, white queen is on d7 (rank 7).
# Let me re-read: White queen on d7 (rank 7), Black queen on g6 (rank 6).
# So rank 7: d7 white queen, f7,g7,h7 black pawns. Also black knight on b7.
# Rank 7: a7 empty, b7 black knight, c7 empty, d7 white queen, e7 empty, f7 black pawn, g7 black pawn, h7 black pawn -> "1n1Qppp" but that's 8 chars: 1 n 1 Q p p p = 7? Let's count: a7=1, b7=n, c7=1, d7=Q, e7=1, f7=p, g7=p, h7=p -> "1n1Qppp" is 7 chars. Need 8: "1n1Qppp" is 7. Actually: "1n1Qppp" = 1+n+1+Q+p+p+p = 7. Missing one. a7 is empty -> 1. b7=n. c7 empty -> 1. d7=Q. e7 empty -> 1. f7=p. g7=p. h7=p. That's 8 squares: 1,n,1,Q,1,p,p,p -> "1n1Q1ppp"? No, standard FEN compresses consecutive empties. So a7 empty (1), b7 n, c7 empty (1), d7 Q, e7 empty (1), f7 p, g7 p, h7 p -> "1n1Q1ppp" but that's 8 chars? Let's write: "1n1Q1ppp" = 1 n 1 Q 1 p p p = 8. Yes.

# Rank 6: a6 empty, b6 empty, c6 empty, d6 empty, e6 empty, f6 empty, g6 black queen, h6 empty -> "6q1" (6 empties, q, 1 empty) = 8.

# Rank 5: a5 white rook, b5-h5 empty -> "R7" (R then 7 empties) but wait, rank 5: a5=R, b5-h5 empty (7 squares) -> "R7".

# Rank 4: a4 empty, b4 empty, c4 empty, d4 empty, e4 empty, f4 empty, g4 empty, h4 white knight -> "7N" (7 empties, N).

# Rank 3: a3 white bishop, b3 empty, c3 empty, d3 empty, e3 empty, f3 empty, g3 black bishop, h3 empty -> "B4b2" ? a3=B, b3-f3 empty (5), g3=b, h3 empty (1) -> "B5b1" but consecutive: B then 5 empties? a3=B, b3,c3,d3,e3,f3 = 5 empties, g3=b, h3=1 empty -> "B5b1". But FEN: "B5b1" = B,5,b,1 = 8.

# Rank 2: a2 empty, b2 empty, c2 empty, d2 empty, e2 empty, f2 white pawn, g2 white pawn, h2 white pawn -> "5PPP" (5 empties, P,P,P).

# Rank 1: a1 empty, b1 empty, c1 empty, d1 empty, e1 empty, f1 empty, g1 white king, h1 empty -> "6K1".

# So FEN: "6k1/1n1Q1ppp/6q1/R7/7N/B5b1/5PPP/6K1 w - - 0 1"

fen = "6k1/1n1Q1ppp/6q1/R7/7N/B5b1/5PPP/6K1 w - - 0 1"
board = chess.Board(fen)
print("Board:")
print(board)
print("\nLegal moves:")
for move in board.legal_moves:
    print(board.san(move), move.uci())

print("\nChecking for mate moves:")
for move in board.legal_moves:
    board.push(move)
    if board.is_checkmate():
        print(f"MATE: {board.san(move)} ({move.uci()})")
    board.pop()
